question: What tradeoff does Andrew Wilkinson describe between building useful AI agents now and making them broadly accessible?
expected_points: Building useful agents currently takes time and technical skill, limiting who can use them.
Wilkinson imagines a future where a simple ChatGPT interface could make AI agents accessible to ordinary business users.
evidence_quote: right now people like me who have the time and skillset to nerd out and build the agents can do this. It's just not accessible to everybody.
